description: Find, price, and book tours, day trips, and activities worldwide, with live dates and prices. Payment happens on tripways.com.

interface.longDescription:
TripWays connects ChatGPT to a live catalog of about 16,000 tours, day trips, and activities in 120 countries, from food walks in Rome to island trips from Phuket.

Ask in plain words. ChatGPT can search by place, budget, duration, activity, and cancellation policy; read a tour's itinerary, inclusions, meeting point, and cancellation terms; check the operator's live calendar for open start times and seats; and price your group (adults, children, seniors) for a chosen date and time.

When you are ready, it gives you a TripWays checkout link with your date, time, and travelers filled in. You pay on tripways.com in your browser. Nothing is purchased inside ChatGPT: the app never holds a seat, creates a cart, or takes card details, and it does not ask for your name, email, or location.

Prices are in USD and come from the operator's booking calendar at the moment you ask. No account or login is needed.
defaultPrompt: Find a street food tour in Bangkok.
Find a snorkeling day trip from Phuket under $100.
Which TripWays destination covers Khao Sok?

positive.prompt: Find a street food tour in Bangkok.
positive.expected_behavior: A short list of Bangkok street food tours (for example Chinatown food tours) with USD prices and tripways.com links. Every tour shown comes from the tool result.

positive.description: Details for one tour by its TripWays id.
positive.expected_behavior: Phang Nga Bay Sunset Seafood Dinner Cruise: inclusions (hotel transfers, guide, canoeing, park fees, seafood dinner), the itinerary, hotel pickup, and a free-cancellation policy, with the tripways.com link.

positive.description: Resolve a landmark to its TripWays destination.
positive.prompt: Which TripWays destination covers Khao Sok?
positive.expected_behavior: Khao Sok is filed under Surat Thani, Thailand, with a link to the TripWays destination page.

positive.description: Live availability for a group over a date range.
positive.prompt: Does TripWays tour 1016530 have space for 2 adults in the next three weeks?
positive.expected_behavior: Upcoming dates with open start times and seats left for 2 adults. The tour runs every Tuesday, Friday, and Sunday.

positive.description: Price a group on an open date, then get the checkout link.
positive.prompt: How much is TripWays tour 1016530 for 2 adults on its next available date? Then give me the booking link.
positive.expected_behavior: A USD total for 2 adults on the next open date (stated as a quote, not a reservation), then a tripways.com/book/ link with that date, start time, and 2 adults filled in. No booking is made in ChatGPT.

negative.description: Flights are not sold by TripWays.
negative.prompt: Find me a flight from London to Bangkok next month.
negative.expected_behavior: TripWays is not called; ChatGPT answers without the app.

negative.description: Hotels are not sold by TripWays.
negative.prompt: Book a hotel room in Paris for two nights.
negative.expected_behavior: TripWays is not called; ChatGPT answers without the app.

negative.description: General travel information that needs no tour data.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Rome tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: TripWays is not called; ChatGPT answers without the app.

review.commerce_description: TripWays (tripways.com) sells tours, day trips, and activities that local tour operators deliver in person. Nothing is sold inside ChatGPT. The plugin searches our catalog, shows tour details, checks live dates and seats, and quotes a price for the traveler's group, then returns a link to tripways.com, where the traveler books and pays in their own browser (external checkout on our own domain). We offer no digital goods, subscriptions, or in-app purchases, and the plugin never collects payment details.

publication.release_notes: First release of TripWays for ChatGPT. Search about 16,000 tours, day trips, and activities in 120 countries by place, budget, duration, activity, or cancellation policy. Check live dates and seats, get the total price for your group, and get a TripWays checkout link with your date, time, and travelers filled in. Payment happens on tripways.com; nothing is purchased inside ChatGPT.
